seoPage.metaDescription: Overnight EV Charging Safety — Home & Society Basics — practical charging guidance for Indian buyers.
seoPage.intro: Overnight AC charging is common in India. This guide covers practical safety — wiring, certified hardware, and rain — without fearmongering or unsafe shortcuts.

editorialSections.title: Why overnight AC is popular
paragraphs: Long parking windows at home or work suit AC charging — you wake up with enough km for the day without waiting at public stations.

editorialSections.title: Safety checklist
bullets: Dedicated circuit and earthing checked by a qualified installer.
OEM-approved or certified wallbox — avoid makeshift extension boards.
Society cabling audited before shared points go live.
Stop using damaged cables or adapters.

misconceptions.reality: Rated outdoor equipment is designed for weather — follow install guidance.
Load, earthing, and cable quality vary — get professional assessment.

faq.question: Is overnight charging safe at home?
faq.answer: With certified install and proper wiring, it is a mainstream pattern — not DIY guesswork.

faq.question: Can I use a regular extension board?
faq.answer: Avoid makeshift setups — see extension board risk guide.

faq.question: Society basement charging?
faq.answer: Requires electrical audit and agreed load limits.

faq.question: Should I charge to 100% every night?
faq.answer: Follow OEM guidance — many owners use a daily ceiling unless a long trip is next day.

faq.question: Next?
faq.answer: Compare models with home AC kW that matches your parking plan.
